stock.description: China Aoyuan Group Limited is actively involved in the development of commercial real estate across a significant international presence, spanning Mainland China, Hong Kong, Australia, and Canada. Its business operations are structured into distinct divisions: Property Development, Property Investment, and an 'Others' segment. Beyond its fundamental development activities, the company also focuses on the acquisition and advancement of diverse real estate initiatives. Additionally, it conceptualizes and manages projects related to cultural tourism, hotel management, sports development, and resort complexes. The firm's extensive portfolio also includes the import and export of a broad spectrum of goods, such as maternal and child care products, beauty and skincare items, apparel and accessories, food and beverages, household articles, and independently imported vehicles. Furthermore, China Aoyuan Group Limited provides a comprehensive medical service platform combining online and offline accessibility, offers expert consultancy, delivers construction solutions, and provides financing services. Established in 1996, and headquartered in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, the company adopted its current name, China Aoyuan Group Limited, in November 2018, having previously operated as China Aoyuan Property Group Limited. This enterprise functions as a subsidiary of Ace Rise Profits Limited.
